ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margins of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation is dominant in the anterior and central regions, with scattered white mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 115 to 125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations, creating a serrated topography with numerous sharp peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Six distinct circular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the dark medial regions, with a higher concentration on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent intersecting linear high-intensity streaks forming a V-shape on the inner-medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Reddish-brown protruding pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; significant ragged appearance at the tips suggests physical trauma or biological encrustation.
